options: The one I stumble on most
questions.a: A) The one I stumble on most. Time follows risk.

questions.q: The final assessment is in the week of ...
Think again: The final assessment can pick any passage. How will you decide what to revise most in eight days?
questions.a: Rank by risk: the passages I stumble on most get the most time, while strong ones get a daily light read.
